title: CSI DECALN — Screen Alignment Pattern
summary: CSI # 8 fills the entire screen with the letter 'E' (the DEC screen alignment test pattern). Used to test display alignment and focus.

terminator_detail.note: No string terminator: the CSI sequence ends at its final byte.

params.name: DECALN
params.meaning: CSI # 8 fills the screen with 'E' characters.

gotchas: DECALN is ESC # 8 (not a standard CSI; it uses the 'private' marker #).
Fills every cell with 'E' to test for missing or misaligned characters.
Often used by terminal emulators as a self-test.

v1_smoke_test.asserts: CSI sequence renders as a byte-exact sequence with final byte '#8'.
